content.overview: The uploaded textbook chapter 'Maps and Locations' develops mathematical reasoning and application through the chapter 'Maps and Locations'.
source_grounded_key_points: Maps And Locations Finding Directions … Manu is facing the rising Sun.
His left hand is pointing in the_______ direction.
His right hand is pointing in the ____________ direction.
Four Little Chicks Four Little Chicks of a bird set out to fly, Spreading their wings they all flew high.
They flew away from East to West, flew North to South, without any rest.
As they flew and explored the land, finally, they returned home, hand in hand.
With their mother, they had so much to share, Our home is the best, beyond compare!” I visited the Bharatpur Bird Sanctuary in Rajasthan and saw an amazing bird called the Siberian Crane!
Do you know that these birds fly all the way from Siberia, a very cold place, to India?
